newValue.text: Observed refillable53 cooldown drives a live tooltip countdown and disabled free-spin button with no RPC while waiting.
Daily game reset restores default free availability even when prior-day cache indicates exhausted quota; account changes and newer snapshots are respected.
Capture-based regressions, typecheck and production build pass; contract/provenance documented.

Add capture-shaped reducer and UI timer/reset tests, update canonical documentation, run typecheck/tests/build.
